page.overview:
Who is Jiyung?

Jiyung was born on Karr Lok Island of the Fire Nation. She attended the island's school, Sunray Academy, where she made three friends: Adaki, Aera, and Sujun.

One day during one of their meditation classes at Sunray Academy, Jiyung realized that Adaki had fallen asleep next to her and woke him up. After class, she, Aera, and Sujun expressed concern for their tired friend. The group's talk was interrupted by another student who declared that a fight between students was taking place at one of the school's training rooms.

Once Jiyung and her friends arrived at the training room, they witnessed a group of sixteen-year-old students easily defeating a group of six graders. Jiyung commented that the older students clearly had an age advantage in regard to their firebending power, yet also demonstrated highly trained skill. After the match, the students were surprised when Chuan, the top firebending teacher of their school, appeared on the stage to declare that they were still seeking fifth graders for a youth team to enter the regional bending tournament. She offered to train any fifth graders who enlisted, despite her students usually being fourteen at the youngest. Much to Jiyung's horror, Adaki suddenly declared that he and his friends would sign up.

Afterward they went to math class, and Jiyung used the opportunity to calculate their winning chances in the regional bending tournament. During the next lunch break, she desperately told Adaki that they had little chance of succeeding, not to mention her own tendency to crack under pressure. Adaki remained unfazed, pointing out that they would fight as a team. Despite also being skeptical, Sujun and Aera also mused how they could use the potential prize money. Realizing that her friends were leaning toward joining the tournament, Jiyung gave in and admitted that they could see how the training would go. As Adaki tried to sign them up, discussed a team name. Though the friends agreed on "Team Adaki" for the time being, Jiyung and the others clarified that the name did not signify Adaki being the official leader.
